name: A Hush Falls Over the World

description.value:
Requirements Your waking world is active.

Sound is absorbed in your waking world, covering everything in a shroud of quiet until the start of your next turn. Creatures in your waking world become hidden to imprecise hearing or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Concealed] to precise hearing. A creature in your waking world attempting to use spell or effect with the auditory or sonic trait must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:4]; on a failure, the spell or effect is disrupted. Anytime a creature in the area is affected by an auditory or sonic effect, they must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:16]. On a success, they are not affected by the auditory or sonic effect, though they still may be affected by other aspects of an ability (for example, a creature hit by a weapon with a thundering rune would not take sonic damage but would still take the normal damage from the weapon).
